concept: S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval: archive with retrieval in minutes
tests: Choosing the cheapest storage class for a rarely used archive retrievable within minutes.
expected: S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval: very low storage cost, expedited retrieval in 1–5 minutes. Triggers: "infrequently accessed archives", "retrievable within minutes", "a few times a year", "MOST cost-effective".
why_not: Standard and Standard-IA cost more for rarely used data; One Zone-IA is a single AZ, not for long-term archives.
